findings.title: Pause and Delete stay hidden without a ruler rule
findings.body: Alert list rows now pass only a Prometheus rule into AlertRuleMenu, and canPause/canDelete are computed from those prom abilities. The Pause item is still rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) is true (line 123), and Delete only when rulerRule is set (line 165), with onClick forwarding that ruler DTO. In the new list both are therefore never shown, even for users who have pause/delete permission. The rewritten GrafanaGroupLoader test grants AlertingRuleDelete and then expects exactly four menu items (silence, copy link, duplicate, export), so it locks this regression in instead of catching it.

findings.title: Silence click does nothing in the ruler-less list
findings.body: List items enable Silence from Grafana Prometheus abilities and AlertRuleMenu calls handleSilence, which only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer is still mounted only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true, and SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer requires a RulerGrafanaRuleDTO. The new GrafanaRuleListItem passes promRule and no ruler rule, so the menu item appears and clicking it never opens a silence drawer.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated to false (with a TODO) instead of calling isFederatedRuleGroup on the combined rule's group. Federated Mimir/GEM groups were previously immutable, so Update, Delete, Pause, Restore, and Delete permanently were not offered. Those actions are now reported as supported for every existing useAlertRuleAbility/useAllAlertRuleAbilities caller, not only the new list, and the UI can offer edits the previous guard blocked.

findings.title: Recording rules lose export, pause, and restore
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities sets isAlertingRule via prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule and uses that flag for ModifyExport, Pause, Restore, and DeletePermanently. The ruler equivalent used rulerRuleType.grafana.rule, which is true for both Grafana alerting and recording rules (only Silence excluded recording rules). Grafana recording rules in the new list therefore cannot be exported or paused even when the user can edit them, and is_paused exists on those rules.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana rules are rendered without a list key
findings.body: Replacing GrafanaRuleLoader dropped key={key} on the grafana branch of the filtered-rule list. Datasource and unknown rows still use key, and getRuleKey still builds a frontend id specifically to avoid duplicate keys. Without it, React reconciles Grafana rows by index as infinite scroll appends pages, so row state (open menus, silence drawer, action buttons) can attach to the wrong rule.

findings.title: Rule view links no longer include returnTo
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleListItem built the view href with createReturnTo() so the rule view could navigate back to the current list URL, including filters and search. The new item links to /alerting/grafana/${uid}/view with no returnTo query. Opening a rule from the list or filtered list drops that context, so Back/return no longer restores the list the user came from.
